What is GenoGluco?

One Platform. Multiple Health Signals. A More Complete View.

Traditional diabetes assessment can involve individual measurements. GenoGluco is designed to bring different available signals together for a more connected understanding of metabolic health.

Clinical Health

Electronic health records, medical history, diagnoses, medications, and clinical assessments.

Laboratory

Blood tests including HbA1c, fasting glucose, lipid profiles, kidney markers, and more.

Glucose

Continuous glucose monitoring data for trends, variability, time-in-range, and patterns.

Genomics

Genetic variants, SNPs, polygenic risk scores, and family history context.

Insulin & Devices

Insulin pump data, basal/bolus delivery, wearable device data, and device metrics.

Lifestyle

Diet, physical activity, sleep patterns, stress levels, and smoking habits.
